prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Adapt a desktop maintenance dashboard to an iPhone task flow. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS. Desktop port has eight dense columns, hover-only row actions, windows opened for every detail and a bottom action hidden under the home indicator. Technician often has one free hand and intermittent connectivity.

criteria.task_completion: Patch content-first phone navigation, safe-area-aware actions, touch-accessible detail tasks and recoverable offline state; retain the repair workflow without transplanting desktop-only interaction.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the designing-for-ios guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Patch content-first phone navigation, safe-area-aware actions, touch-accessible detail tasks and recoverable offline state; retain the repair workflow without transplanting desktop-only interaction.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Patch content-first phone navigation, safe-area-aware actions, touch-accessible detail tasks and recoverable offline state; retain the repair workflow without transplanting desktop-only interaction.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.
